# Fixtures

`box.cached.solidcraft`, `box.lean.solidcraft`, `plain.solidcraft` and `corrupt.solidcraft` are
**synthetic structural fixtures** generated by `scripts/make-fixtures.ts`. Their document bodies are
minimal and are not expected to evaluate in `solidcraft-cli`; they test the container/JSON surface
(reading, cache stripping, rejection).

Put real designs saved by the app in `real/`, with a short note on where each came from and under
which license. Record the CLI version used to produce them. Never commit a design you do not have
the right to redistribute.

Regenerate:

```sh
pnpm tsx scripts/make-fixtures.ts
```
